The bug report indicates that the dimensions change unexpectedly, which suggests these functions may not be calculating the bounds correctly for Ad Hoc Sub Processes.

The functions expandedBounds and collapsedBounds within this class determine the dimensions of a shape when it is expanded or collapsed, which directly relates to the issue of incorrect dimensions. Additionally, the ResizeBehavior class sets minimum bounds on resize, which could influence the default size during the toggle collapse operation. Adjustments in these areas could resolve the unexpected dimension changes.
